prompt_hint: Generate a complete docker-compose.yml for the LOCAL-SOC-SLM lab. Include services: wazuh-manager (port 1514, 1515, 55000), thehive (port 9000), suricata, postgresql with pgvector extension (port 5432), and the soc-engine (our Python app). Define networks, volumes, health checks, and resource limits. Use specific image tags. Include comments explaining each service. Output ONLY valid YAML.

Generate a Wazuh ossec.conf for the LOCAL-SOC-SLM lab. Configure: 1) Syslog input on port 1514, 2) JSON alert output to /var/ossec/logs/alerts/alerts.json, 3) Integration with our Python engine via webhook or file watch, 4) Basic rules for SSH brute force, port scan, and malware detection. Output ONLY valid XML.

Generate the PostgreSQL initialization SQL for LOCAL-SOC-SLM. Create: 1) soc_memory database with pgvector extension, 2) iocs table with daily partitions (iocs_YYYY_MM_DD), 3) case_summaries table with vector column (768 dims), 4) audit_chain table for hash chain, 5) quota_ledger table. Include indexes and constraints. Output ONLY valid SQL.
